command: echo "== node =="; node --version; echo "== launchagents =="; ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents 2>/dev/null; echo "== remote =="; git remote -v | head -1; echo "== README head =="; head -12 README.md; echo "== backlog search =="; backlog search "agent hours" --plain 2>/dev/null | head -8; backlog search "badge" --plain 2>/dev/null | head -5; backlog search "metrics" --plain 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "== pkg scripts =="; grep -A15 '"scripts"' package.json | head -20; echo "== records PR pattern =="; grep -rn 'records-log-' src --include=*.ts | head -5; echo "== codex archived w/ approval cwd =="; grep -l '"cwd":"/Users/carter/dev/approval-md' ~/.codex/archived_sessions/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | wc -l; ls ~/.codex/archived_sessions | wc -l; echo "== codex sessions with approval cwd, by whether auto-review =="; grep -l '"cwd":"/Users/carter/dev/approval-md' ~/.codex/sessions/2026/*/*/*.jsonl > /dev/null; grep -c '"model":"codex-auto-review"' $(grep -l '"cwd":"/Users/carter/dev/approval-md' ~/.codex/sessions/2026/*/*/*.jsonl) | grep -c ':0$'
